import json, subprocess

def act(turn_deg, move_m):
    res = subprocess.run(['python3', '/app/act.py', json.dumps({'turn_deg': turn_deg, 'move_m': move_m})], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return json.loads(res.stdout)

# Current heading after frame 8 is 315 deg (since 0 + 7*45 = 315).
# To face 0 deg (+y), we turn +45 deg:
out9 = act(45, 0.4)
print('obs 9:', out9['frame'], out9['status'], out9.get('collision'))

# Turn 45 to face 45 deg, take a picture
out10 = act(45, 0)
print('obs 10:', out10['frame'], out10['status'], out10.get('collision'))

# Turn 270 (-90) to face 315 deg, take a picture
out11 = act(-90, 0)
print('obs 11:', out11['frame'], out11['status'], out11.get('collision'))
"
